    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]

    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    source = [row[r0:r1+1] for row in grid[c0:c0+w]]
